text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text:
She mighta lost, but Inari was still great
out there!
Definitely one of the better
runners today!

text_block_list.name: Townswoman
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Sob... That was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Inariiiii! You're so cool!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Yeah... You really were close...

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
She lost... This won't help Inari One's
reputation
of being inconsistent.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
But she can still turn things around! All
she has to
do is pull off a decisive
victory at her next race.
You can do it,
Inari One! I believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Aaagh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Dammit, dammit, damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Now I'm even further from becomin'
Umamusume
of the Year!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Creek, you did great out there! I know
you'll win
next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
You've got what it takes, Super Creek!
Your
running's the real deal! Luck just
wasn't on your
side today, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I promise to win my next race—the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Creek's so confident in herself! She doesn't have any doubt that she'll be the one to win and rise to the top!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (And Oguri's the same...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Rrgh! Damn it! I'm the one who's gotta win though! I've gotta! So why... Just why?!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Why do I still believe they're better
than me?)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Why don't I feel like the real deal?)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Lemme run in the Arima Kinen. Please.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Creek's runnin' in it, and so will Oguri.
So that's
where I'm gonna beat 'em.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just defeatin' one of 'em isn't enough. I
gotta
prove I'm better than both of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I gotta do this. I needa win if I'm ever
gonna reach
the top!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we set the Arima Kinen as our
next
goal, so Inari One can have a
rematch against
Oguri Cap and Super
Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, while training...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Ack!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine, Boss! Lemme keep goin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine, Boss! Lemme keep goin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to waste a single second! I
gotta
keep trainin'—I'm not good
enough!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I dive forward to catch Inari One just
before she
collapses and lands face-first
on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sorry... I musta slipped on someth—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You gotta be kiddin' me! I don't have
time to rest!
The Arima Kinen's right
around the corner!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But whazza point of runnin' if I can't be
the best?!
choice_data_list: その前に君が走れなくなる！！
その前に貴方が走れなくなる！！

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Y'know what Oguri and Creek are doin'
right
now? Trainin'! And gettin' miles 'n'
miles ahead of
me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
They're gonna be even stronger than
they were at
the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna claim a huge victory over 'em
and take
the seat at the very top, then I
gotta put my life
on the line and train
like I mean it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone's countin' on me... I...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna... let 'em...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One loses all strength halfway
through her
sentence. She falls again,
and this time, she's so
exhausted she
can't even speak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I end up taking her to the infirmary,
where she's
instructed to rest in her
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to the doctor, physical
exhaustion
played a part in her collapse,
but the main cause
was her severe
mental distress.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm such a joke...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I'm so mentally weak I
couldn't
even finish up my trainin'
without collapsing... I'm
pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Forget becomin' the best... I can't ever
face
everyone back home again...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.
choice_data_list: 今はとにかく、ちゃんと休もう

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Damn it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen her so worn out before.
Just
thinking about her defeated
expression makes my
heart ache.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels wrong to reassure her that she'll
be able to
train again soon. All I want is
to ease the burden
on her heart and
cheer her up.
choice_data_list: 何か、俺がしてあげられることは――
何か、私がしてあげられることは――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want her to return to her normal fiery
self... I'm
her partner—I should be able
to do something.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wahoo! Wahoo!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's more like it! Keep those festival
vibes
goin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, that includes you too! Wahoo!
Wahoo!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This place is part of who I am. I'm only
the stylin',
fearless Edo girl I am...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...'Cause of the people livin' here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I sift through the memories I shared
with Inari
One, I manage to think of
something that might
be able to help
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Except, if I try it now, what if it has the
opposite
effect?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's skills as a racer are the result
of her
bond between her and the people
of her
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The only thing I can do is place my faith
in that
bond!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, I muster up my determination
and
reach out to Chief.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And together, we discuss what we'd like
to do for
Inari One.
